news.headline: Vertex Pharmaceuticals Announces FDA Extension for Povetacicept BLA Review
news.summary: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has extended the target action date for the Biologics License Application for Vertex's povetacicept by up to three months.

news.headline: Coign Capital Advisors LLC Acquires Shares of Vertex Pharmaceuticals Incorporated
news.summary: Coign Capital Advisors LLC has reported a new investment position in Vertex Pharmaceuticals Incorporated.

news.headline: Coherent Director Stephen G. Pagliuca Purchases $15.22 Million in Common Stock
news.summary: Coherent Corp. director Stephen G. Pagliuca acquired 82,000 shares of the company's common stock in a transaction dated November 20, 2026.

news.headline: Tradr ETFs Announces Launch of Triple Threat Series Including Memory ETF Featuring SanDisk
news.summary: Tradr ETFs announced the upcoming launch of a new 'Triple Threat' series of leveraged ETFs, which includes a fund providing 200% daily exposure to a basket of memory stocks, including SanDisk Corporation.

news.headline: SanDisk Chief Accounting Officer Discloses Stock Sale in SEC Filing
news.summary: Michael Pokorny, Vice President and Chief Accounting Officer of SanDisk, sold 26,016 shares of company stock in a transaction reported on November 25, 2026.

news.headline: Evercore and BNP Paribas Adjust Ciena Price Targets
news.summary: Analysts at Evercore and BNP Paribas have revised their price targets for Ciena Corporation, with both firms lowering their targets to $375.

news.headline: Newmont Corporation Declares Dividend Payable in December 2026
news.summary: Newmont Corporation is scheduled to trade ex-dividend on November 25, 2026, with a dividend payment of $0.26 per share.

news.headline: Director Transaction: Kurt Dobitsch Purchases Nemetschek SE Shares
news.summary: Nemetschek SE reported a director's dealing transaction involving the purchase of company shares by Kurt Dobitsch.

news.headline: Bernstein Warns of Potential Growth Slowdown for Datadog in 2027
news.summary: Bernstein analysts cautioned that frequent software system failures and enterprise freezes on system updates could negatively impact Datadog's growth in 2027.

news.headline: Datadog Director Alexis Le-Quoc Sells 44,400 Shares of Common Stock
news.summary: Datadog, Inc. director Alexis Le-Quoc sold 44,400 shares of company stock for approximately $7.49 million, according to a recent SEC filing.

news.headline: TD Cowen Initiates Coverage on Axon Enterprise with Buy Rating
news.summary: TD Cowen analyst Chris Krueger has initiated coverage of Axon Enterprise with a buy rating and a price target of $650.

news.headline: PT Freeport Indonesia Announces Redemption of 2027 Senior Notes
news.summary: PT Freeport Indonesia has issued a notice to redeem all of its outstanding $750 million in 4.763% senior notes due 2027 on December 24, 2026.

news.headline: Freeport-McMoRan's Indonesian Joint Venture Closes $750 Million Senior Notes Offering
news.summary: Freeport-McMoRan's Indonesian joint venture, PT Freeport Indonesia, has successfully completed the offering of $750 million in senior notes.

news.headline: Bernstein Maintains Hold Rating on Hewlett Packard Enterprise and Adjusts Price Target
news.summary: Analyst firm Bernstein has maintained its 'Hold' rating on Hewlett Packard Enterprise while lowering the target price to $60.

news.headline: Ensign InfoSecurity and HPE Partner for AI-Powered Sovereign Security
news.summary: Ensign InfoSecurity and Hewlett Packard Enterprise have announced a collaboration to provide AI-powered security operations for organizations operating in sovereign or isolated environments.

news.headline: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Reports Record Quarterly Revenue and Increases Share Repurchase Authorization
news.summary: HPE reported $14.5 billion in revenue for the October quarter and raised its fiscal year revenue growth guidance to 27%–35%, while also authorizing an additional $5 billion for share repurchases.

news.headline: Arista Networks Gains Market Share in AI Back-End Ethernet Switches
news.summary: According to a Dell'Oro Group report, Arista Networks increased its market share in the AI back-end Ethernet switch sector during the third quarter of 2026.

news.headline: Arista Networks Insider Executes Stock Sale
news.summary: An insider at Arista Networks, Inc. sold shares valued at approximately $1.74 million, as disclosed in a recent SEC filing.

news.headline: Keystone Law Group plc Announces Director Disclosure
news.summary: Keystone Law Group plc issued a regulatory disclosure regarding the past directorship of its Chairman, Robin Williams, at Headlam Group plc.

news.headline: Keysight Technologies Officer Files Notice of Proposed Stock Sale
news.summary: Keysight Technologies officer Satish Dhanasekaran has filed a Form 144 notice indicating an intent to sell 14,890 shares of company common stock.

news.headline: ITRI Launches 6G-FORMOSA Testbed in Collaboration with Keysight
news.summary: The Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI) has launched 6G-FORMOSA, a shared testbed platform developed in collaboration with Keysight Technologies to accelerate 6G technology validation.
